subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl permanently support externally configured local archive-provider subprocesses as a stable versioned protocol, including its configuration, source-precedence, checkpoint, and environment-isolation contract?
rationale: The branch adds a broad durable extension surface and a local-process trust boundary; code review alone cannot choose the repository’s long-term supported contract.

options.title: Approve the provider contract with proof
options.body: Keep the explicit JSONL subprocess model, remove release-owned changelog content, and require redacted fresh-install and upgrade runtime evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Limit the first release to a smaller documented import contract and defer replay or checkpoint features until their compatibility guarantees are separately approved.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers prefer archive adapters to remain outside Slacrawl until a clearer extension strategy is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve the provider contract with proof
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit JSONL subprocess model, remove release-owned changelog content, and require redacted fresh-install and upgrade runtime evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed provider contract and both implementation commits, making them the best available routing candidate for the design discussion.
